sql:
with s as (select market_ticker tk, at, best_yes_bid b, yes_levels_json::jsonb lv, lag(best_yes_bid) over w pb, lag(yes_levels_json::jsonb) over w plv, lag(at) over w pat from incentive_market_snapshots where market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION%' and at > now() - interval '5 days' window w as (partition by market_ticker order by at)),
e as (select tk, pat, at, pb, b, (select coalesce(sum((x->>1)::numeric),0) from jsonb_array_elements(plv) x where (x->>0)::int > b) gone from s where pb is not null and b < pb and extract(epoch from at-pat) < 1800)
select tk, to_char(at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') t, extract(dow from at) dow, pb, b, gone::int,
 (select best_yes_bid from incentive_market_snapshots z where z.market_ticker=e.tk and z.at > e.at + interval '2 hours' order by z.at limit 1) b2h,
 (select best_yes_bid from incentive_market_snapshots z where z.market_ticker=e.tk and z.at > e.at + interval '8 hours' order by z.at limit 1) b8h
from e where gone >= 150 order by at
